name: easy-communication
description: Thai and English communication support and optional practice for autistic communicators. Age-eligible direct use; adult-prepared materials for younger learners. Prototype, not therapy.

interface.longDescription: Two skills help people express their own messages or choose short communication practice. Thai and English, one question at a time, stable numbered choices, free-text answers, and stop/skip controls. Learners can communicate using a single word without completing a sentence. Intended for age-eligible users; adults can prepare offline materials for younger learners. ChatGPT under-13 interactions must be adult-conducted; ages 13–17 require parental consent. Claude consumer use is 18+. No diagnosis, therapy, outcome guarantees, persistent tracking, custom buttons, or built-in speech. Prototype; not tested with children or installed in live consumer apps yet.
